This reconstruction on SWCCGDB (2018) tracks the contemporary Scrye magazine championship lists (Gravity Shadow from [[Jedi Pack]]; Gold Leader In Gold 1 / Red Leader In Red 1 from [[Rebel Leader Packs]]). Starting location is the Scrye-starred site.

== Introduction ==

I never start with Obi-Wan's Hut! This would ruin all of my deck's strategy.

My basic strategy with my light side is to get a droid on the Yavin 4: Massassi War Room the quickest I can, so that I can play a How Did We Get Into This Mess? I really love this card. A lot of strategy comes with it.
